QuestInfo.name: Raging Mrs. Ming Ming
QuestInfo.0: Chief Stan seemed quite displeased about something. Find out what it was.
QuestInfo.1: Mrs. Ming Ming is severely upset since Chief Stan has forgotten about their wedding anniversary. Chief Stan needs Mushroom Caps to gift Mrs. Ming Ming to ease her anger go get it for him even if you don't think it will ease her anger.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta retrieved a gift for Mrs. Ming Ming on behalf of Chief Stan, but it seemed to make her mad!

0.0: Seriously, what's wrong with her? Why is she making such a fuss about anniversaries? It's not like I forgot her birthday. \r\n#L0##bMaybe this is more important to her.#l\n#k
0.1: I didn't do anything wrong! Ugh, I'm going starving to death if I don't convince her to make me a meal. Why didn't I sign up for that cooking class like she told me?! Ugh... I guess I have to try and make it up to her. ONLY because I'm hungry.

yes.0: Ugh, what would make a great gift... How about mushrooms? My wife, Mrs. Ming Ming, cooks a mean mushroom dish. I fell in love with her because of her cooking skill... Among other reasons! #r10#k #r#t4000953##k, #r#t4000957##k, and #r#t4000955##k each would make a great gift. And that means I can have mushrooms dinner today!

1.0: My husband sent a gift? Oh my, I guess starving him really did the trick.

default.0: I cannot let this slide. I mean, we're talking about our wedding anniversary! He will never forget this day again.

npc.0: If you give Mrs. Ming Ming #r10#k #r#t4000953##k, #r#t4000957##k, and #r#t4000955##k each, you might get a little of her cooking, too.
